# MUXARO

> MUXARO is an ad-free, zero-credit all-in-one Video, PDF, and Media Studio. Built with Next.js App Router and self-hosted WebAssembly engines (`FFmpeg WASM`, `QPDF WASM`, `PDF.js`, `pdf-lib`, `Tesseract.js`), MUXARO combines 14 hybrid Video & Audio Studio tools, 38 browser-local zero-upload PDF utilities, and 8K/4K stream downloading with automatic 60-minute ephemeral worker cleanup.

## Core Suites

- [Studio Home](https://muxaro.app/): Universal URL & file dropzone (supports links up to 8K plus direct browser-local routing for MP4, MKV, MP3, PDF, DOCX, and PPTX).
- [All 52 Studio Tools](https://muxaro.app/tools): Searchable directory spanning Video Studio (14), PDF Studio (38), and the upcoming Audio Studio roadmap.
- [Video Studio (14 tools)](https://muxaro.app/tools?section=video): Target-size compressor (10 MB Discord / 16 MB WhatsApp), lossless trimmer & 60s splitter, 105+ format converter, audio extractor, GIF/WebP, EBU R128 loudness normalizer, 9:16 smart pad, subtitle burner/shifter, metadata scrubber, A/V merger, clip joiner, batch/playlist ZIP hub, frame grabber, and transcript extractor.
- [PDF Studio (38 browser-local tools)](https://muxaro.app/tools/pdf): 100% client-side, zero-upload PDF creation (invoice/receipt/quote), editing (edit, sign, fillable AcroForms, merge, split, rotate, crop, watermark, Bates headers), optimization (3-tier QPDF compression, repair, pixel-diff + word-diff compare, batch), conversion (camera scan, image/Word/PowerPoint to PDF, multi-worker OCR searchable PDF, lossless image extraction), and security (WebCrypto PKCS#7 verification, AES-256 protect/unlock, sanitize).
- [Audio Studio Roadmap](https://muxaro.app/tools?section=audio): Active audio workflows today plus upcoming stem separation, voice de-noise/de-reverb, waveform silence trimming, and podcast mastering.
- [Documentation](https://muxaro.app/docs): Guides covering Video Studio, PDF Studio, Audio Studio, containers vs. codecs, 8K bitrate realities, psychoacoustics, troubleshooting, and security.

## Key Operational Guarantees

- **Zero Credits & Zero Ads**: No daily credit walls, no rewarded ads, no watermarks, and no mandatory accounts.
- **Browser-Local Zero Upload**: All 38 PDF tools and Tier-1 media tools (`<= 350 MB`) run locally inside the browser tab with 0 bytes uploaded.
- **Ephemeral Cloud Workers**: Remote FFmpeg worker files and temporary outputs purge automatically within 60 minutes.
